title: Video
description: A video that loads only when it is played: its poster first, the video after a click. On a page: <pd-components-video src="/assets/videos/…" poster="/assets/…" width="…" height="…" />.

src.description: The video's path in the assets, without the extension: <src>.av1.mp4 (AV1, played where the browser can) and <src>.mp4 (H.264, everywhere else) sit side by side

poster.description: The poster, a raster image in the assets: the video's first picture, shown until it plays

label.description: What the poster does, as its accessible name: say what plays ("Play the tour of the landing page")

width.description: The video's width in pixels, as encoded

height.description: The video's height in pixels, as encoded
